newsitem.title: USA: SAFECO units under review by A.M. Best.
newsitem.headline: SAFECO units under review by A.M. Best.

text.p: A.M. Best Co on Monday said it placed the ratings of two SAFECO Corp subsidiaries and American States Group under review with negative implications.

The insurance rating concern said the action followed SAFECO's announcement that it entered into a definitive agreement to purchase American States, a subsidiary of Lincoln National Corp, for $2.8 billion plus the assumption of $300 million of debt.
SAFECO initially will finance the transaction with $2.5 billion of short-term and intermediate-term bank debt and a $600 million extraordinary dividend from the SAFECO Insurance Cos.

"As a result, debt to total capital is expected to increase substantially to nearly 50 percent following the close of the transaction, resulting in financial leverage well above Best's superior rating standards," A.M. Best said.

Operationally, A.M. Best views the transaction positively over the longer term because of the enhanced market position in agency distribution, geographic diversification and expected revenue and cost synergies, A.M. Best said.
The two SAFECO subsidiaries affected are its property/casualty and life/health units.
